result.summary: The page is largely well-formed, but the promotional banner has a clear visual defect: its white text is rendered on a pale green background, making the headline and instructions nearly unreadable. No other broken elements were observed beyond expected carousel/viewport clipping.

issues.description: The promo banner text ('3 free deliveries for you' and 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10') is white on a very light mint-green background, resulting in extremely low contrast so the offer details are barely legible.
issues.suggestion: Use a darker banner background (e.g., the brand's deep green) or switch the banner text to a dark color so it meets WCAG contrast requirements against the light green.
